title: Octopod
teaser: Applied research into generative design tools for advanced manufacturing.
headline: Applied research that turned generative design from an abstract capability into workflows people could evaluate.
challenge: Generative design research needed product language, manufacturing context, and interface patterns clear enough for internal teams to test.
outcome: Ali helped shape research reviews, exhibit storytelling, and interaction studies that made topology optimization and advanced manufacturing workflows easier to understand.
bullets: Translated generative design research into critique-ready workflow concepts.
Connected manufacturing constraints with interface patterns that could support internal beta adoption.
Used exhibit and kiosk studies to make advanced design tooling easier for non-specialist stakeholders to evaluate.
